content:
I drop my AirPods Pro all the time, and just yesterday I dropped them by a lake. The worst part is watching them bounce across the ground, terrified they'll go down a storm drain or something. I love having a case that won't bounce away when dropped. ESR's new FlickLock MagSafe case is specifically designed for the AirPods Pro 3 to solve this problem. It adds a secure locking lid and powerful MagSafe magnetic attachment.

MagSafe Monday column: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of Apple's wireless charging capabilities.

FlickLock Lid Design

The standout feature of this case has to be the lid. ESR has combined strong magnets with internal latches so that the lid stays completely secure. You can easily pop it open one-handed using the front sliding lock, but it absolutely will not bounce open on its own. I've tested it, and even without dropping them, the earbuds don't pop open in my bag or anywhere else. This is the biggest selling point of ESR's new case.

Adding a case to your AirPods can sometimes weaken the magnetic connection with the charger. ESR has built its own magnets into the back of the case to completely solve this problem. It holds firmly onto MagSafe accessories and won't move at all.

The case uses a polymer construction with Air Guard shock-absorbing corners to protect your charging case from the worst drops and impacts. It's held up well so far while still being lightweight and easy to carry. It's available in several attractive colors to match your style, and ESR even includes a lanyard that you can attach to keys, backpacks, and more. You can wear it on your wrist or securely clip it inside a bag for quick access.

ESR Pulse FlickLock Case Wrap-Up

If you want peace of mind knowing you won't lose one of your AirPods Pro 3 earbuds, the ESR Pulse FlickLock is a great option. The sliding lid design is something you can't go back from once you've tried it. I never thought about this feature with previous cases, but it's quickly become my favorite. If you use a MagSafe charger on your desk or nightstand, this case will keep your AirPods Pro 3 closed, protected, and always fully charged, whether at home or on the go.

You can pick up the ESR Pulse FlickLock MagSafe Case (for AirPods Pro 3) directly from Amazon or ESR's website.
